blocks.text: Factory and generator: grows food from nothing.
blocks.title: Farm

blocks.text:
Factory and generator: makes energy.
Pause power in the world panel.
blocks.title: Power Plant

blocks.text:
Factory and extractor: digs minerals out of the world's crust.
Pause mining in the world panel.
blocks.title: Mine

blocks.text: Factory and extractor: draws spice from the world's reserve (deepest on Desert, Barren Moon and Paradise worlds, shallowest on Terran and Molten ones). Every spice comes out of the reserve; it stops when that is empty.
blocks.title: Spice Extractor

blocks.text: Factory: makes research tokens. While nothing is researching, tokens pile up in the research menu and are spent as soon as research starts again.
blocks.title: Laboratory
